`GET /invoices/<id>` now returns a 404 when the invoice doesn't exist. Before this change it crashed with a 500, because the code called `invoice.__dict__` on `None`.

The change in `src/api/invoices.py:12-13` returns the error using the project's standard `errors.problem(...)` helper from `src/api/errors.py`, so the response is `application/problem+json`, not a one-off dict:

```python
if invoice is None:
    return errors.problem(404, "Invoice not found", f"No invoice with id {invoice_id!r}")
```

I checked it with a one-off request through Flask's test client. `GET /invoices/x` returned status 404, type `application/problem+json`, and a body with `title: "Invoice not found"`. I didn't add a permanent test to `tests/`; I can add one if you'd like.
